description: Internal implementation of string joining utilities in the Abseil C++ library, including formatters, join algorithms, and tuple handling.

classes.name: StreamFormatterImpl
classes.description: Formats types to strings using stream insertion operator.

classes.name: PairFormatterImpl
classes.description: Formats std::pair objects with specified formatters and separator.

classes.name: DereferenceFormatterImpl
classes.description: Wraps another formatter to dereference pointers before formatting.

classes.name: JoinTupleLoop
classes.description: Template struct to iterate over tuple elements for joining.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Formats a value using the specified formatter.

methods.name: JoinAlgorithm
methods.description: Joins elements in a range with a separator, using a formatter.

methods.name: JoinRange
methods.description: Joins elements of a range into a string with a separator.
